policy.eligibilityRule: A provider record in this file is research evidence only. It does not become a recommendation route until product class, number control, lifecycle and service-compatibility fields pass route-level review.
policy.officialFactRule: Provider-published claims are stored as provider claims unless independently verified. Unknown fields stay unknown.
policy.communitySignalRule: Community claims require a traceable source URL and source date. Unsourced forum excerpts may select research targets but are not persisted as success-rate or latency facts.
policy.measurementRule: Success rate and latency metrics are reserved for our own timestamped measurements with attempt counts. Provider or forum percentages are never promoted to measured performance.
policy.dynamicPriceRule: Marketplace and rental prices are snapshots or starting prices, never guaranteed checkout prices.

country_coverage.note: The public page states multi-country coverage but the exact live country inventory is not treated as fixed evidence.

number_control.note: The provider describes long-term rentals as dedicated lines. Ownership after rental expiry is not documented on the reviewed public page.

rental_term.renewal_rule: Provider states renewable within validity; recovery after expiry is unknown.

price.note: Public starting price only; exact country/number price can vary.

long-term-rental.expiration_rule: Renewable within validity. Exact post-expiry recovery or reassignment rule is unknown.

sources.label: LongSMS — long-term lines and pricing overview

number_control.note: Public page describes one-off verification; durable control is not claimed.

renewable-rental.provider_claimed_number_type: US non-VoIP with physical SIM association

country_coverage.note: Provider FAQ says its numbers are US-based.

number_control.note: The provider markets renewable rentals as retainable indefinitely with continued payment, but its Terms state provided numbers are not user property, are temporary, and may change at the provider’s discretion.

rental_term.renewal_rule: Provider says renewable lines auto-renew before expiry when auto-renew is enabled and account funds are sufficient; continued billing can retain the line indefinitely.

overdue_recovery.note: Provider rental glossary states overdue renewable rentals can be recovered for 3 days after expiry.

price.note: Current public starting price for renewable rentals; exact service/options can vary.

renewable-rental.expiration_rule: If renewal fails, the rental becomes overdue. The provider glossary states a 3-day overdue recovery window; continued access to the same number is not represented as guaranteed ownership.
renewable-rental.number_reuse_rule: Provider Terms reserve discretion over number availability; do not assume permanent reservation outside an active/recoverable rental.

sources.label: TextVerified — rental FAQ and renewal behavior
TextVerified — rental glossary and 3-day overdue recovery

fixed-term-rental.provider_claimed_number_type: US non-VoIP with physical SIM association

number_control.note: Current public offer lists 1–14 day rental access. This is temporary access, not permanent ownership.

rental_term.renewal_rule: Non-renewable lines cannot be renewed or reactivated after expiry; provider FAQ says they may be extended only while still active.

price.note: Current public starting price; exact service/options can vary.

fixed-term-rental.expiration_rule: Expires at the chosen fixed term. Do not rely on later recovery.

number_control.note: Verification numbers are short-term; after a verification ends the provider says the number may be removed at any time.

verification_window.note: Provider FAQ says the assignment window varies by service.

one-time-verification.refund_rule: Provider states credits are deducted only when a verification arrives and no-code cases are automatically refunded.
